verdict.rationale: Gazebo can run headless as a server-only process (-s flag, GUI-free gz-sim-server package), and custom plugins can drive robot, sensor, and environment control without a GUI. That allows unattended background simulation runs. However, none of the evidence describes an automation feature as such; users would have to assemble it themselves from headless mode, plugins, CLI tools and gz-transport. Missing for 10: scheduling/trigger mechanisms, a documented automation or job-management workflow, agent/AI integration for autonomous tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration.
